axes.build_axis: 0 = chat assistant, 10 = platform users build apps/agents on
axes.deploy_axis: 0 = vendor cloud only, 10 = on-prem / sovereign / any cloud
axes.access_control: 0 none beyond login; 1 per-user; 2 per-document/row-level; 3 capability/scoped-credential; 4 capability + derivative/data-flow tracking

meta.grade_note: Axis scores are the author's own judgement (grade C) informed by vendor docs; pricing and UK facts carry their own source grades in pricing.json.

sources.name: Channel Insider on Cloudflare OS partners
Jet Admin Appsmith / Budibase / ToolJet guides
TNW: UK reviews GBP 330m NHS Palantir deal

competitors.name: Excelcion (target)
competitors.access_control_note: target: capability-scoped credentials plus derivative/data-flow tracking across generated apps and agents
competitors.uk_presence: UK-founded; target UK public sector and regulated mid-market
competitors.pricing_note: TBD
competitors.one_line_pitch: Enterprise wrapper around vibe-coding platforms: governed, sovereign-deployable app and agent building.

competitors.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
competitors.access_control_note: Inherits Microsoft Graph per-item permissions and Purview sensitivity labels; no capability scoping of agent actions beyond Graph ACLs (Microsoft Learn: Copilot data, privacy and security).
competitors.uk_presence: Dominant; UK Government Copilot cross-departmental pilot 2024-25, widespread NHS/central-government deployment; UK data residency in Microsoft UK regions
competitors.pricing_note: $30/user/month add-on (Business tier GBP 16.10, promo 13.80); E7 Frontier Suite $99 bundles Copilot from Jul 2026
competitors.one_line_pitch: AI assistant inside the Office apps every UK enterprise already licenses.

competitors.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
competitors.access_control_note: Agents run under maker/user identity with Graph and Dataverse row-level security; connectors governed by DLP policies, but no per-agent capability tokens (Copilot Studio security docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Sold via every UK Microsoft partner; used by councils and NHS trusts for FAQ/service agents
competitors.pricing_note: $0.01/credit PAYG or $200/25k credits; free credits for M365 Copilot-licensed users
competitors.one_line_pitch: Low-code agent builder for the M365 tenant, metered by credits.

competitors.name: Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps / Automate)
competitors.access_control_note: Dataverse security roles with table/row/column-level security; environment DLP policies; no derivative tracking (Power Platform security docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Very large citizen-developer footprint in UK government and NHS; UK Power Platform regions
competitors.pricing_note: Power Apps Premium GBP 15.40/user (GBP 9.20 at 2,000 seats); per-app plan retired Jan 2026
competitors.one_line_pitch: The default low-code platform for UK enterprises on Microsoft.

competitors.name: Google Gemini for Workspace / Gemini Enterprise (ex-Agentspace)
competitors.access_control_note: Respects source-system ACLs across connectors (per-document); IAM roles per agent; Google Distributed Cloud offers air-gapped Gemini for sovereign cases (Gemini Enterprise docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Google Cloud London region; UK public-sector footprint smaller than Microsoft; G-Cloud listed via partners
competitors.pricing_note: Gemini bundled into Workspace (Business Std GBP 11.80); Gemini Enterprise $21 / $30 / ~$50-60 per seat plus metered overage
competitors.one_line_pitch: Search-and-agent platform over Workspace and connected enterprise data.

competitors.name: OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise
competitors.access_control_note: SSO/SCIM, workspace roles, custom GPT sharing controls and connector-level permissions; no row-level or capability model (OpenAI Enterprise privacy docs).
competitors.uk_presence: OpenAI London office; MoU with UK Government (Jul 2025) and UK data residency offered; used across Whitehall pilots
competitors.pricing_note: Business $20-25/seat; Enterprise quote-based, reported $45-75/seat
competitors.one_line_pitch: Frontier chat assistant with custom GPTs and connectors, enterprise data controls.

competitors.name: Anthropic Claude Enterprise
competitors.access_control_note: SSO/SCIM, role-based permissions, project sharing, audit logs; MCP connectors carry user-level OAuth; available via AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex for region control (Claude Enterprise docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Anthropic London office; MoU with UK Government (Feb 2025); Claude available in UK regions via Bedrock
competitors.pricing_note: Team $20-25 standard / $100-125 premium seat; Enterprise quote-based (reports range $20 seat + tokens to ~$60)
competitors.one_line_pitch: Claude with projects, artifacts and Claude Code for enterprise knowledge work.

competitors.name: Retool
competitors.access_control_note: Granular app/resource/query permissions and permission groups on Business+; self-hosted on Enterprise; no capability tokens for agents (Retool permissions docs).
competitors.uk_presence: London office opened; UK customer base in fintech/scale-ups; limited UK public-sector references
competitors.pricing_note: Team ~$10 / Business $50-65 per builder; end users $5-10; self-host only on Enterprise
competitors.one_line_pitch: Internal-tool and agent builder for engineering teams, now with AI credits.

competitors.name: Appsmith
competitors.access_control_note: Granular access control (roles on apps, pages, datasources) on Business/Enterprise; audit logs; self-hosted by default (Appsmith GAC docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Community adoption; no notable UK public-sector references found
competitors.pricing_note: Business $15/user; Enterprise from $2,500/mo (100 users)
competitors.one_line_pitch: Open-source internal-tool builder with self-hosted licence keys.

competitors.name: Budibase
competitors.access_control_note: Role-based access with per-app roles and row-level filtering via data-source views; SSO/SCIM on paid tiers (Budibase RBAC docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Belfast-founded UK company; NHS and local-authority users cited in Budibase marketing
competitors.pricing_note: App users $5, creators $50 (annual); self-hosted free with unlimited apps/agents
competitors.one_line_pitch: UK-built open-source low-code with cheap end-user seats and free self-hosting.

competitors.name: ToolJet
competitors.access_control_note: Groups and granular app/data-source permissions; self-host community edition (ToolJet permissions docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Minimal UK footprint
competitors.pricing_note: Starter $24 / Pro $99 / Team $249 per builder; community edition free
competitors.one_line_pitch: Open-source low-code app and agent builder priced per builder.

competitors.name: Windmill
competitors.access_control_note: Workspace/folder-level RBAC, per-resource and per-variable permissions, audit logs on Enterprise; scripts run with resource bindings but no data-flow tracking (Windmill docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Minimal UK footprint
competitors.pricing_note: Dev seat $20, operator $10, plus $120/mo base and compute units; free tier to 10 SSO users
competitors.one_line_pitch: Developer-first scripts/flows/apps platform, self-hostable anywhere.

competitors.name: Grist
competitors.access_control_note: Row- and column-level access rules per document with formula-based conditions; self-hosted community and enterprise (Grist access-rules docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Small UK presence; used by some European public bodies (French government deployments)
competitors.pricing_note: Pro $8-10, Business $24-30 per user; self-hosted Enterprise on quote (min 50)
competitors.one_line_pitch: Open-source relational spreadsheet with granular access rules and AI assistant.

competitors.name: Directus
competitors.access_control_note: Policy-based permissions with item-level filter rules per collection and field; BSL self-host (Directus permissions docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Minimal UK-specific footprint
competitors.pricing_note: Cloud $15 / $99 / $299 per project-month; self-host free under $5m revenue
competitors.one_line_pitch: Headless data platform and app builder over any SQL database.

competitors.name: Nextcloud (Hub + Assistant)
competitors.access_control_note: File-level ACLs, group folders, file access control rules; local AI Assistant runs on-prem; no capability model for agents (Nextcloud admin docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Modest UK presence; strong in EU public sector (German federal government, French ministries)
competitors.pricing_note: Enterprise EUR 53-205 per user per year by tier/volume; Assistant only in Ultimate
competitors.one_line_pitch: Sovereign collaboration suite with a local AI assistant.

competitors.name: Palantir AIP / Foundry
competitors.access_control_note: Ontology-level markings, purpose-based access and row/column policies with data lineage; AIP Logic agents act through ontology permissions with audit (Palantir security docs). Closest incumbent to a data-flow model.
competitors.uk_presence: NHS Federated Data Platform GBP 330m; MoD and Home Office contracts; London office; contract under political review with 2027 break clause
competitors.pricing_note: No public per-seat price; enterprise contracts
competitors.one_line_pitch: Ontology-centred operational AI platform for government and defence.

competitors.name: Glean
competitors.access_control_note: Permissions-aware search mirroring source-system per-document ACLs; agent builder inherits same (Glean security docs).
competitors.uk_presence: Glean Technologies UK Ltd incorporated 2025; London Tech Week exhibitor; UK enterprise logos, few public-sector references
competitors.pricing_note: Reported $50+/user plus ~$15 each for generative and agent add-ons; $100k+ minimums
competitors.one_line_pitch: Permissions-aware enterprise search and agents over SaaS knowledge.

competitors.name: Cloudflare OS (open source; managed version planned)
competitors.access_control_note: Agents get typed bindings not raw keys; Gatekeeper Workers enforce per-service scoped policies; the system records every resource an agent reads and 'policy follows what the agent has seen' (Cloudflare OS launch blog). Runs in the customer's Cloudflare account, not on-prem.
competitors.uk_presence: Cloudflare London office and UK data localisation; Cloudflare OS itself is early-access (Aug 2026) with no UK references; implementation partners Presidio and Happy Cog are US-based
competitors.pricing_note: Apache-2.0, no licence fee; runs on Workers/Workers AI usage pricing; managed dashboard product announced without date
competitors.one_line_pitch: Open agent workspace with capability-scoped credentials and observation tracking, deployed in your Cloudflare account.

competitors.name: Kainos
competitors.access_control_note: Services firm; inherits the control model of whatever platform it deploys (typically Azure/M365/Workday).
competitors.uk_presence: Belfast HQ; FY26 revenue GBP 431m, 3,475 staff; GBP 136m public-sector digital revenue; claims 7th largest AI supplier to UK public sector (GBP 66m awarded since 2018); Home Office, DfT, DVSA, NHS England, GBP 150m Defra deal
competitors.pricing_note: T&M / outcome-based; Workday products GBP 89m ARR
competitors.one_line_pitch: UK's largest listed public-sector digital and AI delivery partner.

competitors.name: Made Tech
competitors.access_control_note: Services firm; control model inherited from client platform.
competitors.uk_presence: UK public sector only; FY26 revenue GBP 58.9m (+27%); GBP 19m GDS contract; central government, NHS, local government
competitors.pricing_note: T&M via G-Cloud and DOS frameworks
competitors.one_line_pitch: Public-sector-only digital and AI delivery specialist.

competitors.name: BJSS (CGI)
competitors.access_control_note: Services firm; control model inherited from client platform.
competitors.uk_presence: BJSS acquired by CGI (2025); CGI UK ~6,000 staff with long-standing MoD, DWP, NHS and Scottish Government contracts
competitors.pricing_note: T&M / managed service
competitors.one_line_pitch: Scaled UK engineering consultancy inside a global SI.

competitors.name: Faculty Frontier (Accenture)
competitors.access_control_note: Identity federation, MFA, ISO 27001; per-user access, no published row-level or capability model (G-Cloud listing).
competitors.uk_presence: London HQ, acquired by Accenture Jan 2026; NHS England Early Warning System, multiple NHS G-Cloud listings; UK and EEA data residency
competitors.pricing_note: G-Cloud GBP 1,000-250,000 per unit per month
competitors.one_line_pitch: Decision-intelligence platform plus delivery, deployed in the buyer's cloud.

competitors.name: Databricks (Genie / Agent Bricks)
competitors.access_control_note: Unity Catalog row filters, column masks and lineage; agents governed by catalog grants; runs in customer's AWS/Azure/GCP account (Databricks Unity Catalog docs).
competitors.uk_presence: London office; NHS, HMRC and Shell references; UK regions on all three clouds
competitors.pricing_note: No seat fee; 150 DBU (~$10.50) free LLM usage per user per month from Jul 2026, then PAYG
competitors.one_line_pitch: Data-lakehouse-native analyst and agent tooling billed on consumption.

competitors.name: Snowflake Cortex / Snowflake Intelligence
competitors.access_control_note: Row access policies, masking policies and RBAC applied to Cortex Search/Analyst and agents (Snowflake governance docs).
competitors.uk_presence: London office; UK public-sector via partners; UK regions on AWS/Azure
competitors.pricing_note: AI Credits $2.00-2.20; $0.12-5.10 per M tokens; no seat fee
competitors.one_line_pitch: Warehouse-native LLM functions and agents over governed data.
